cases.title: Hypomethylation of mismatch repair genes MLH1 and MSH2 is associated with chemotolerance of breast carcinoma: Clinical significance
cases.basis: The publisher retracted the article after an investigation confirmed duplicated images and cross-paper band reuse; the requested original data were unavailable and the explanation did not resolve the concerns.

cases.title: Human macrophages differentially produce specific resolvin or leukotriene signals that depend on bacterial pathogenicity
cases.basis: The 2023 correction replaced misleading re-plotted chromatograms with direct captures and added complete replicate source data; no later retraction was located through 2026-09-12.

cases.title: HOXA5-miR-574-5p axis promotes adipogenesis and alleviates insulin resistance
cases.basis: The editor retracted the article after confirming altered image reuse across several figures and finding further reuse between different groups in original files.

cases.title: Localized nuclear reaction breaks boron drug capsules loaded with immune adjuvants for cancer immunotherapy
cases.basis: The 2023 correction replaced mislabeled figure axes and inaccurate source-data files and stated the conclusions were unchanged; no later retraction was located through 2026-09-12.

cases.title: microRNA-7 upregulates death receptor 5 and primes resistant brain tumors to caspase-mediated apoptosis
cases.basis: After a 2024 expression of concern, the journal investigation found irregularities in the cited figures; supplied replacements did not overcome reliability concerns, and the editor retracted the article.

cases.title: Distinct neurexin-cerebellin complexes control AMPA- and NMDA-receptor responses in a circuit-dependent manner
cases.basis: The 2023 correction disclosed copy-paste and calculation errors, published corrected values after reanalysis, and updated the source data; no later retraction was located through 2026-09-12.

cases.title: Dietary Supplementation of the Antioxidant Curcumin Halts Systemic LPS-Induced Neuroinflammation-Associated Neurodegeneration and Memory/Synaptic Impairment via the JNK/NF-kB/Akt Signaling Pathway in Adult Rats
cases.basis: The publisher confirmed image concerns and unattributed reuse, found the authors' raw-data response insufficient, and retracted the article because the data and conclusions were considered unreliable.

cases.title: An anti-influenza A virus microbial metabolite acts by degrading viral endonuclease PA
cases.basis: The 2023 correction updated the animal timeline, units, cohort descriptions, methods, table, and source data and stated the main conclusions were unaffected; no later retraction was located through 2026-09-12.
